A minimum of one and a maximum of three(3) adjacent companion seats may be purchase for each wheelchair accessible seat. Additional seats, up to the advertised limit, will try to be found in close proximity. Only 1 companion is guaranteed to be in the same section as the guest, depending on availability.

generalInfo.generalRule: Chase Field has a CLEAR BAG policy. Approved bags include Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) with no obscured interior pockets. Cannot exceed 12in x 6in x 12in Plastic Storage Bag (Re-sealable, clear) 1 Gallon. Small Clutch Bags/Wallets No larger than 6.5in x 4.5in Approximately the size of a hand with or without a handle or strap. All small clutch bags/wallets within your clear tote bag MUST FIT the approved dimensions above (6.5in x 4.5in). Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas. Cannot exceed 18in wide. Clothing and blankets are permitted if carried loosely or in an approved clear bag
